summary: Section 18 (Geocoding + Proximity + Translate fallback) backend + frontend smoke tested. 15/15 backend pytest pass: /api/geocode cache hits for Dallas/Miami/Sallisaw (source='cache'), uncached city falls through to Google with source='google' (Boston: lat=42.355, lng=-71.057 ✅), invalid input returns 422, /api/admin/geocode/seed requires admin and is idempotent (total_seed=24, second call inserted=0), GET /api/providers?lat=35.5&lng=-94.8&radius_km=50 returns María at distance_km<5 with closest-first sort and distance_km field present, GET /api/providers WITHOUT lat/lng has NO distance_km (regression OK), POST /api/translate gracefully returns source='api_error' (Cloud Translation blocked on GCP project — as documented), noop case returns source='noop', provider availability (Phase E) regression OK. Frontend smoke: /search loads, all key testids present (search-city-input, search-near-me, search-q-input, search-submit, identity-filter-chips), CityAutocomplete accepts plain text even though Maps JS Places shows referrer-restriction alert (graceful), Near Me with mocked geolocation DOES fire /api/providers?lat=35.5&lng=-94.8&radius_km=50, NO gtag/GA4 console errors (no-op as expected with empty REACT_APP_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID), Landing/Plans/Provider eCard all load without runtime errors. ONE FRONTEND BUG FOUND: distance badges DO NOT render in the UI. The code at Search.jsx:366-368 only renders distance-badge inside split-card-* (Split view), and Split view's rendered list comes from mapProviders (which calls /providers/map and does NOT carry distance_km). The default List view's result-card-${slug} block has NO distance badge code at all. Net effect: backend correctly returns distance_km but UI never displays it to users.

ui_bugs.issue: distance-badge element is only defined inside split-card branch (lines 366-368). The List view result-card has no distance badge rendering. When user clicks 'Near me' in default List view, backend returns distance_km on every result but UI never shows it.

Split view renders from mapProviders (which is /providers/map, sans distance_km), so even the split-card distance-badge code at line 367 never fires when Near Me is active. The proximity fetch into `providers` state is not the source for split-card rendering.

issues: Google Maps modal 'This page can't load Google Maps correctly' alert appears in top-right due to referrer restriction on GOOGLE_API_KEY. Expected per task scope — user must add referrer restrictions in GCP console. Graceful degradation works: input keeps functioning as plain text.
Legacy Places API error in console (2x): 'You're calling a legacy API, which is not enabled for your project. Switch to Places API (New).' — expected per task; UI not broken.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 4861 lines (still growing — split into routers strongly recommended before next section). Section 18 cleanly adds geocode + seed without polluting global state.

_geocode_lookup() catches all exceptions and returns None; that hides root cause from caller. Consider logging the Google API response status/body when status != 'OK' for easier debugging of REQUEST_DENIED / OVER_QUERY_LIMIT.

city_coordinates collection has no unique index on (city,state) — relies on upsert filter. Add db.city_coordinates.create_index([('city',1),('state',1)], unique=True) on startup to prevent dupes if seed race-condition ever happens.

Frontend useGeolocation hook + Search.jsx proximity logic is gated by `!cur.city` (line 78). If user has typed a city then clicks Near Me, the lat/lng is silently dropped. Recommend either clearing the city field on Near Me click OR documenting the precedence with a UI hint.
AnalyticsTracker / analytics.js no-op behavior verified: with empty REACT_APP_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID, zero gtag errors fire across full app navigation. Safe.

Sec 18 seed log: did not explicitly verify 'Sec 18: seeded N city_coordinates' log line (would need supervisor backend log access during a fresh DB), but admin seed endpoint returns inserted=0 on subsequent calls — confirms idempotency.

rca of the issue: Distance badge missing in UI: Search.jsx line 367 placed the [data-testid='distance-badge-${p.slug}'] span inside the split-card-${p.slug} block (lines 348-388), which is in the Split view branch. In Split view, however, the list column iterates over `mapProviders` (filled by fetchMap() → /providers/map → no distance_km field). The default List view branch (around line 457, result-card-${p.slug}) renders from `providers` (which DOES have distance_km when proximity is active) but contains no distance-badge JSX at all. Reproduce: open /search, clear city, mock geolocation 35.5,-94.8, click Near Me — observe network call /api/providers?lat=35.5&lng=-94.8 returns providers with distance_km, but DOM has zero [data-testid^='distance-badge-'] elements. Mitigation: add the same distance badge JSX block (with Navigation icon + p.distance_km.toFixed(1)) into the result-card map around line 462-467 of Search.jsx.
